newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia producer price index up 14.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Colombia producer price index up 14.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: Colombia's producer price index rose 14.5 percent in 1996, compared to a 15.4 percent rise in 1995, the central bank said on Monday.
In December 1996, the index rose 0.3 percent, compared with an 0.8 percent increase the previous month.
The annual rise is the lowest since 1993, according to central bank.
The central bank said the index of goods produced and consumed in the country rose by 15.8 percent in 1996, while the index for imported goods rose 6.1 percent.
The producer price index is seen as an good indication of the trend in consumer prices. The most recent consumer price figures are due out on Thursday.

Consumer price inflation for the year to November was running at 20.76 percent, well above the 17 percent annual target set by the central bank. In view of the slowdown in the producer price index in December, the annual consumer rate may come in at a little more than 21 percent.
